name: power
label: Power
tagline: Power modes and what starts at login

manifest.summary: One slider that switches the laptop between Cool, Auto and Performance by changing CPU, firmware, kernel and screen settings, with automatic switching on the charger, a hotkey, a 10-minute graph and on/off switches for login autostart entries.

features.name: Mode slider
features.description: Applies a mode file from modes/ through the root helper with no password prompt, then sets the laptop panel refresh rate.

features.name: Switch automatically
features.description: Picks a mode for battery and one for the charger; forge-power-watch.service applies it within 5 seconds of plugging in or unplugging, with Forge closed.

features.name: Hotkey
features.description: Super + Alt + P runs cycle.py to step through the modes with a notification.

features.name: Live readings and graph
features.description: Governor, turbo, frequency cap, energy preference, firmware profile, power limits, temperature, fan, battery draw, measured CPU watts, and a 10-minute chart of temperature, battery draw and CPU speed.

features.name: Autostart switches
features.description: Turns ~/.config/autostart entries on or off with Hidden=true; takes effect at next login.

features.name: Top processes
features.description: Read-only list of what is using CPU and memory right now, with buttons to mark a process background or protected.

features.name: Background tasks
features.description: An editable list of process-name patterns to renice lower (background) or never touch (protected), applied continuously by forge-power-priority.service. Needs no root: lowering your own process's niceness doesn't require privilege.

manifest.data_dir: /var/lib/forge-power (last applied mode, written by the helper); ~/.config/forge-power/auto.json (auto-switch choice); ~/.config/forge-power/priority.json (background-task list and nice level)
services: forge-power-restore.service (system; re-applies the last mode at boot)
throttled.service (kept; its power limits are never changed by shipped modes)
earlyoom.service and zram swap (installed by helper/install.sh)
known_gaps: helper/install.sh must be run by the user with sudo; until then modes cannot be applied.
Autostart switch effect and boot restore are only observable after a logout or reboot.
CPU package watts need the root helper; the graph shows laptop draw on battery instead.
